### The Lord Returns to His People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-returns-his-people
Passage: Isaiah 40:1-5
Points:
- God assures His exiled people that judgment and exile are not their ultimate destination.
- True restoration cannot be accomplished by human effort; it requires the return of God's presence.
- The imagery of leveling terrain calls believers to spiritual preparation to receive the Lord.
- God's rescue acts as a new exodus to deliver His people out of the wilderness.
- Salvation is designed to display God's glorious character before all the nations.

### A Prayer to Prepare Our Hearts
Author: Jessica Van Roekel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-prepare-our-hearts.html
Passage: Isaiah 40:3-5
Points:
- Isaiah's wilderness highway points to the arrival of Jesus and John the Baptist's message.
- Preparing a highway for the Lord involves repentance and discarding sinful habits.
- Difficult circumstances and personal valleys serve as opportunities to grow and display God's glory.
- Believers prepare their hearts for eternity by fixing their focus on Christ's presence.
